purpose: Show the native environment preflight for five seconds by default, allow Space/Enter to skip, and run it before the original asset-free dry-run notice.
application: Back up local work, then extract the incremental ZIP from /path/to/workspace/ so paths under amiwind/ overlay an exact dev6 source state. No deletions are required. Rebuild and boot the dry-run HDF before calling dev7 native-validated.
notes: Historical release files and presets remain in the repository unchanged.
The dry-run startup order is FailAt 10 -> AmiWindCheck -> AmiWindDryRun.
The five-second pause is timer-backed; Space or Enter continues immediately.
